quests.scene: You are asked to reflect on the nature of genuine professional excellence in your field at its highest level [20].
options: Describe the technical mastery required.
Describe the leadership qualities required.
Articulate the integration of deep technical mastery sound professional judgment intellectual honesty and genuine service to the people and purposes your field exists to serve.
Describe the reputation and recognition that distinguishes the best.
